project_type: Full-stack TypeScript - Vite React SPA (frontend) + Express API on Supabase (backend)
build_system: Vite 6 for frontend, esbuild for server.ts bundling. MUST run 'source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh' before any npm/node commands.
test_framework: No test framework configured (no jest/vitest). Validation is via lint + build.
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && npm run lint' (tsc --noEmit). 2. Run 'source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && npm run build' (vite build + esbuild server.ts). Both must pass with exit code 0.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Must source nvm before any npm/node commands. react-router-dom NOT installed yet - needs to be added.
contribution_requirements: Push to branch feat/complete-school-website. Meaningful commits per logical chunk.
key_patterns: Components in src/components/. Single AppContext for auth/language state. Tailwind CSS 4 with @import 'tailwindcss'. Motion (framer-motion) for animations. Lucide-react for icons. Material Symbols Outlined loaded via CDN for some icons. Design system CSS variables in src/index.css. Geist + Noto Sans Devanagari fonts. Language toggle with t(en, mr) pattern.
directory_structure: src/components/ - UI components. src/contexts/ - React contexts (AppContext). src/data/ - static data. src/lib/ - utilities/helpers. src/types/ - TypeScript types. src/utils/ - utility functions. server/ - Express API. api/ - Vercel serverless functions. vercel.json - SPA rewrites configured.
